verses.en: If it had not been the LORD who was on our side, now may Israel say;
verses.pt: Diga, Israel: O que seria de nós se o SENHOR não estivesse conosco?
verses.en_web: If it had not been Yahweh who was on our side, let Israel now say,
verses.en_bbe: <A Song of the going up. Of David.> If it had not been the Lord who was on our side (let Israel now say);

verses.en: If it had not been the LORD who was on our side, when men rose up against us:
verses.pt: Se o SENHOR não estivesse conosco, quando os homens se levantaram contra nós,
verses.en_web: if it had not been Yahweh who was on our side, when men rose up against us;
verses.en_bbe: If it had not been the Lord who was on our side, when men came up against us;

verses.en: Then they had swallowed us up quick, when their wrath was kindled against us:
verses.pt: Eles teriam nos devorado vivos, quando o furor deles se acendeu contra nós.
verses.en_web: then they would have swallowed us up alive, when their wrath was kindled against us;
verses.en_bbe: They would have made a meal of us while still living, in the heat of their wrath against us:

verses.en: Then the waters had overwhelmed us, the stream had gone over our soul:
verses.pt: As águas teriam nos coberto, e a corrente de águas teria passado por sobre nossas almas.
verses.en_web: then the waters would have overwhelmed us, the stream would have gone over our soul;
verses.en_bbe: We would have been covered by the waters; the streams would have gone over our soul;

verses.en: Then the proud waters had gone over our soul.
verses.pt: Águas violentas teriam passado por sobre nossas almas.
verses.en_web: then the proud waters would have gone over our soul.
verses.en_bbe: Yes, the waters of pride would have gone over our soul.

verses.en: Blessed be the LORD, who hath not given us as a prey to their teeth.
verses.pt: Bendito seja o SENHOR, que não nos entregou como presa aos dentes deles.
verses.en_web: Blessed be Yahweh, who has not given us as a prey to their teeth.
verses.en_bbe: Praise be to the Lord, who has not let us be wounded by their teeth.

verses.en: Our soul is escaped as a bird out of the snare of the fowlers: the snare is broken, and we are escaped.
verses.pt: Nossa alma escapou como um pássaro da armadilha dos caçadores; a cadeia se quebrou, e nós escapamos.
verses.en_web: Our soul has escaped like a bird out of the fowler’s snare. The snare is broken, and we have escaped.
verses.en_bbe: Our soul has gone free like a bird out of the net of those who would take her: the net is broken, and we are free.

verses.en: Our help is in the name of the LORD, who made heaven and earth.
verses.pt: Nosso socorro está no nome do SENHOR, que fez o céu e a terra.
verses.en_web: Our help is in Yahweh’s name, who made heaven and earth.
verses.en_bbe: Our help is in the name of the Lord, the maker of heaven and earth.
